item: Bedroom cleanup: box-only stages under AUTH #046 while AUTH #051 is pending (stage 1 coverage, stage 3 planar proxies + Unity composite, stage 6 camera bounds, stage 4 licence check)
privacy: Metrics and text only. Bedroom frames, plane textures, coverage PNGs and the proxy proposal stay in chmod-700 /workspace/owner-capture/work/cleanup (box only; nothing uploaded). One geometry-only top-down coverage heatmap (colour bins + camera path, no imagery) is in /workspace/gj-owner-share/ for the Owner; it is not in git.

inputs.sparse: GLOMAP model from the private Modal volume gj-corpus:/owner-capture/room-01/sparse (274 frames, 229 registered), downloaded to the box (approved via the auto-review card; #046 infrastructure)

settings.blur: below the 25th percentile Laplacian variance of the observing frames

stage1_coverage.threshold_choice: 5 views / 6 deg: 5 views is the 25th-percentile floor where splats stop being constrained; 6 deg sits between p5 and p25 parallax so it flags pan-only regions without labelling the whole pan-heavy video weak (10 deg flags 26%).
stage1_coverage.finding: Almost nothing above 1 m reconstructs (26 of 1286 voxels; none above 1.8 m) because the capture pitched down about 59 deg. The weak regions are parallax-dominated (panning from one spot) and sit at floor/furniture height around the bed. A standing 1.4 m viewer therefore looks at upper walls the video never saw; a reshoot with level chest-height sweeps and a slow upward pass is the only real fix for the upper room.

fit_fixes: constrained refit keeps the floor/wall axis
ceiling must sit above every camera (a bed top was labelled ceiling)
rectangle fill metric (16x16 occupancy) rejects RANSAC planes threaded through clutter
partial-view mosaic texture bake (median of the 5 sharpest frontal views per texel; alpha 0 where unseen)
stage3_planar_proxies.ceiling: none found (no points above the cameras)
stage3_planar_proxies.unity: SplatRoomDescriptor.planeProxiesEnabled (default false) + planeProxies[]; SplatRoomLoader.BuildPlaneProxies draws unlit alpha-cut quads (GJ/PlaneProxy, queue AlphaTest) before the ZTest-Always splat composite, so splats land on top. Textures load from Resources/<resource>-planes/ which only the private package carries. Committed descriptors keep it off; the bedroom proposal is not applied.
stage3_planar_proxies.proposal_tool: services/reconstruction/tools/cleanup_proxies.py (prints a proposal; never edits a descriptor)

stage6_camera_bounds.note: Lowers the camera ceiling from 2.17 to 1.67 m (the strong-coverage volume + 0.3 m and the 95th-percentile capture-camera height). Not applied; it goes into the descriptor only with the stage-6 Owner build after #051.

stage4_licence_check.repair_model: Our shippable fixer (#045 phase 4): img2img-turbo / pix2pix-turbo code (MIT, GitHub licence API) fine-tuned by us; its pix2pix_turbo.py loads the tokenizer, text encoder, VAE and UNet from stabilityai/sd-turbo.
stage4_licence_check.base_model: stabilityai/sd-turbo (distilled from Stable Diffusion 2.1). Hugging Face LICENSE.md = Stability AI Community License Agreement, last updated 2024-07-05 (repo last modified 2024-07-10); the model card says 'intended for both non-commercial and commercial usage'; SD Turbo is listed on stability.ai/core-models.
terms: Commercial use allowed royalty-free while we and our affiliates have under USD 1M annual revenue; above that the licence terminates and an Enterprise licence is needed
Commercial use requires registering with Stability AI (an Owner action; not done)
Our fine-tuned fixer is a Derivative Work we own (subject to Stability's rights); outputs are ours to the extent the law allows (outputs are not Derivative Works)
If we distribute the model or a product that uses it: ship the licence, a Notice file with the Stability attribution line, and 'Powered by Stability AI' in docs/about
Comply with the Stability Acceptable Use Policy; do not use outputs to build or improve a foundation generative model
stage4_licence_check.result: COMMERCIAL-OK WITH CONDITIONS for our own SD-Turbo fixer: under the USD 1M revenue cap, after the Owner registers with Stability AI, with attribution kept in the third-party notices. Not unconditional: before shipping repaired content, the Owner registers and counsel confirms the attribution reading.
stage4_licence_check.not_shippable: nvidia/difix weights and Difix3D+ code: NVIDIA License, model card 'research and development/non-commercial use only' (base also SD-Turbo). Eval-only under #045; its outputs never go into any build or package, including internal-debug builds of the bedroom.
stage4_licence_check.baseline: LaMa (advimman/lama) Apache-2.0: per-view inpainting baseline with no revenue cap.

tests: services/reconstruction: 315 passed, 11 skipped (adds fill, ceiling, mosaic bake and keep_reason tests); Unity EditMode PlaneProxyTests (default off, validation, mesh UV order, shader compiles).
blocked: Stages 2, 4 (generation) and 5, plus the Owner builds for stages 3 and 6, wait for AUTH #051. AUTH #051 was not logged in governance/AUTHORIZATION_LOG.md at the time of writing.
